products.title: Waxed Canvas Dog Lead
products.description: A 1.5m lead in waxed cotton canvas with a solid brass trigger clip and a padded handle. Wipes clean.

products.title: Brass-Buckle Collar
products.description: An adjustable collar in vegetable-tanned leather with a brass buckle and a riveted D-ring. Sized small through large.

products.title: Packable Travel Bowl
products.description: A collapsible silicone bowl that folds flat to 2cm and clips to a lead or belt loop. Holds 400ml.

products.title: Oatmeal Dog Shampoo
products.description: A mild colloidal oatmeal shampoo for itchy or sensitive skin, free of parabens and artificial fragrance. 250ml.

products.title: Cotton Rope Tug Toy
products.description: A hand-knotted tug toy in undyed cotton rope, sized for medium and large dogs. Machine washable.

products.title: Felted Wool Cat Mat
products.description: A dense felted wool mat that holds warmth and resists clawing, sized 45cm square for a windowsill or shelf.

pages.about: Rowan & Bracket is a two-person workshop making pet goods we could not find for our own animals. We cut, stitch and finish everything ourselves, in batches of a few dozen at a time. If something wears out sooner than it should, tell us and we will put it right.
pages.refund_policy: Returns accepted within 30 days of delivery, provided items are unused and in their original packaging. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of receipt. Return postage is paid by the customer unless the item is faulty.
pages.shipping_policy: Flat rate shipping of $5.00 on all orders, free over $75. Orders placed before 2pm ship the same business day; delivery is 3-5 business days. We do not currently ship outside the United States.
